kpis.name: Precision AI Integration
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of AI-based surgical planning software for the Recon segment
kpis.description: Acquisition on October 5, 2023, of Precision AI, developer of advanced surgical planning software. This software has capabilities for shoulder reconstruction with expansion opportunity to other anatomies, strengthening the value proposition of the Reconstructive segment
kpis.signal: Adoption of AI to enhance products and processes

kpis.name: Lima Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Major integration of a global orthopedic company specialized in digital innovation
kpis.description: Acquisition on January 3, 2024, of Lima, a private global company specialized in restoring movement through digital innovation and personalized hardware solutions for 865.6 million USD, including contingent consideration. This acquisition substantially expands the product offering of the Reconstructive segment internationally
kpis.signal: Transformational acquisition for the Recon segment

kpis.name: Dr Comfort Operations Divestiture
kpis.explanation: Sale of U.S. podiatric care operations Dr Comfort from the PR segment
kpis.description: On October 7, 2025, Enovis sold its U.S. podiatric care solutions operations Dr Comfort to Promus Equity Partners for an initial amount of 45 million USD, with up to 15 million USD additional based on achievement of future milestones. This divestiture reflects a portfolio rationalization strategy within the Prevention and Rehabilitation segment

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.score_rationale: The medical technology industry is highly competitive. Enovis faces increasing competition that could compress margins and reduce market share, particularly in high-growth segments such as joint reconstruction.

risks.title: Evolving Regulatory Environment
risks.score_rationale: Global medical regulations and quality standards continue to evolve. The company must invest substantially to maintain compliance, which could increase operating costs and reduce margins.

risks.title: Export Dependence and Foreign Exchange Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: With 42% of sales from regions outside the United States, Enovis is exposed to foreign exchange risks and trade barriers. Currency fluctuations and geopolitical tensions may impact profitability and competitiveness.

risks.title: Inflationary Pressures
risks.score_rationale: While inflation has not historically significantly impacted costs, inflationary pressures since 2021 are affecting raw material and energy costs. Enovis must pass these increases through price increases to protect margins.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: Enovis completed 7 acquisitions in 2025 and the major Lima acquisition: 865.6 M USD in 2024. Complex integration of these entities presents significant risks of inefficiency, talent loss and value destruction.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: As a medical device supplier, Enovis is an attractive target for cyberattacks. Data breaches, ransomware and system disruptions could cause significant damage to reputation and operations.

risks.title: Technology Continuity Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Enovis relies heavily on its IT systems, software: notably Precision AI, and digital tools. Technology failures, obsolescence or disruptions could significantly affect production and distribution capacity.

risks.title: Trade Tariffs and Trade Restrictions
risks.score_rationale: New tariffs announced by the U.S. government in early 2025 have increased input costs. Additional trade restrictions or retaliatory trade measures could increase costs and limit supply chain flexibility.

ai_positioning.summary: Enovis is actively integrating AI into its operations and product solutions. The acquisition of Precision AI in October 2023 provided advanced surgical planning software applicable to shoulder reconstruction and other anatomies. The company uses AI to enhance its products and processes in both its Prevention and Rehabilitation and Reconstructive segments, positioning AI as a key lever for clinical innovation and improvement in patient outcomes.
